question: Who among the following sportsmen was in news in June 2021 for being inducted into the ICC Hall of Fame ahead of WTC Final?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Javagal Srinath.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The ICC Hall of Fame is a recognition given to the best cricketers in the history of the sport.
 
• It was established by the International Cricket Council (ICC) in 2009.
 
• **Javagal Srinath:**
 
 
• He is a former **Indian cricketer** who played for the Indian national team from **1991 to 2002.**
 
• He was known for his** fast bowling **and played a key role in India's victory in the** 2002 NatWest Series** final against **England.**
 
• In** June 2021, **he was **inducted into the ICC Hall of Fame** along with former **Zimbabwean cricketer Andy Flower **and** former Australian cricketer Monty Noble.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dilip Vengsarkar:**

 
 
• He** **is a former Indian cricketer who played for the Indian national team from **1976 to 1992.**
 
• He was a **part of the Indian cricket squad that took home the World Cup in 1983.**
 
• Additionally, Vengsarkar guided his country's team to **victory in the 1988 Asia Cup. **
 
• The greatest accolade bestowed upon a former player by the BCCI**, the C. K. Nayudu Lifetime Achievement Award, was given to him in 2014.**
 
 
 
• Vinu Mankad:
 
 
• Mulvantrai Himmatlal "Vinoo" Mankad, who played 44 Test matches for India between 1946 and 1959, was a former captain of the Indian cricket team.
 
• He was born on April 12, 1917, and passed away on August 21, 1978.
 
• His opening partnership of 413 runs with Pankaj Roy in 1956, which set a world record and remained until 2008, is what made him most famous. 
 
• In cricket, Mankading is named after him for running out a batsman who is "backing up" at the non-striker's end.
 
• He was admitted to the ICC Cricket Hall of Fame in June 2021.
 
• In 1973, the Indian government bestowed upon him the civilian honor of Padma Bhushan.
 
• The Vinoo Mankad Trophy, an under-19 domestic event in India organized by the BCCI, bears his name.
 
 
 
• **Ajay Jadeja:** 
 
 
• He is a former Indian cricketer who played for India from **1992 to 2000. **
 
• He participated in **196 One Day Internationals and 15 Test matches.**
 
• At the time, he was **considered as one of the Indian team's top fielders. **
 
• **Jadeja and Mohammed Azharuddin share the record for the greatest one-day partnership, having played against Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe, respectively, at the fourth and fifth wickets. **
